response.sql: SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_ram) as avg_of_site_avgs_ram, AVG(site_avg_ratio) as avg_of_site_avgs_ratio FROM (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) as site_avg_ram, AVG(CASE WHEN sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu > 0 AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(sp.procgpu AS FLOAT) / CAST(sp.proccpu AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as site_avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) site_avgs GROUP BY entrystat ORDER BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: When computing the GPU-to-CPU ratio, rows where procgpu or proccpu is NULL, or where proccpu is 0 (avoiding division by zero), are excluded from the ratio calculation only—not from the initial filtering stage. These excluded rows contribute to RAM averages but not to ratio averages.
For the ratio calculation, CAST to FLOAT is needed to avoid integer division, since both procgpu and proccpu are SMALLINT.

alternatives.interpretation: Rows with NULL or zero-valued proccpu, or NULL procgpu, should be excluded from the initial filtering stage (WHERE clause), so they contribute to neither RAM nor ratio averages.
alternatives.sql: SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_ram) as avg_of_site_avgs_ram, AVG(site_avg_ratio) as avg_of_site_avgs_ratio FROM (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) as site_avg_ram, AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS FLOAT) / CAST(sp.proccpu AS FLOAT)) as site_avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu > 0 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) site_avgs GROUP BY entrystat ORDER BY entrystat
